name: gift_of_paradise_on_opponents_land
notes: Printed: 'Enchant land. When this Aura enters, you gain 3 life. Enchanted land has "{T}: Add two mana of any one color."' P0 casts it on P1's Forest: P0 (the Aura's controller) gains 3. The granted ability belongs to the land, so P1, its controller, taps it for two red into P1's pool; P0's pool stays empty.
